title: feat(app-shell): the Studio landing mounts the console header, AppHeader's new studio variant (objectui#11863, Q1)
body:
Part of #11863 (Q1)

Clause-②: yes. This widens a published type of `@object-ui/app-shell`: the exported `AppHeader` component's `variant` prop accepts a fourth member, `'studio'`, beside `'app'`, `'home'` and `'orgs'`. The union (`AppHeaderVariant`) is not exported by name, since the package entry exports `AppHeader` only, so a host meets it as the prop's type, and a host that switches exhaustively over that type must handle `'studio'`. A call with no `variant` resolves as before. No export is added or removed. The changeset is `minor` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `patch` for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console`.

This covers only Q1 of objectstack-ai/objectui#11863, per the retriage ruling (Q1 → A): the `/studio` header. Q3 landed in #11996. Q2, search on `/studio`, follows in a later round, so #11863 remains open.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`: `AppHeaderVariant` gains `'studio'`, a sibling of `'orgs'`. It draws the brand logo, then a fixed Studio crumb read from `console.studio.title`, as `'orgs'` draws `organizations.title`. Everything else is the header's own, unchanged: the inbox, help and the account menu (profile, workspaces, theme, language, notification switches, sign-out). The `app`, `home` and `orgs` drawing is untouched; the only other edits are comments that list the frames.
- `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`: `StudioLanding` mounts `AppHeader` with `variant="studio"` in the header `HomeLayout` uses (same classes), in place of its wordmark link. `StudioPackageBuilder` and the recent-package record (Q3) are untouched.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, all ten packs: `console.studio.backToHome` (the wordmark's tooltip) retires with its reader, and `console.studio.title` ("Studio") takes its place in the same `console.studio` block. "Studio" is a product name every pack already writes in Latin script inside its own Studio strings, so the value is the same in every pack.
- `packages/app-shell/README.md`: the one place it lists the header's surfaces ("Platform preview badge") now names `studio`.
- `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md`.

Why `console.studio.title` and not a new family: the `orgs` crumb reads its own frame's `title` row (`organizations.title`). The Studio front door's own rows already lived in `console.studio` (`backToHome` was its only row), so the crumb is that block's `title`. No new key family.

## Hypotheses, measured

**H1 holds.** Browser drive, Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x900, the console's built `dist` served by `vite preview` (base `054fd8441` on one port, this branch on another), API mocked with `page.route` (signed-in admin holding `studio.access`, one org, two packages). Before and after, at `/studio`:

| | base `054fd8441` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| visible interactive elements in the header (1440) | `a: Back to home -> /home` | `a: ObjectOS -> /home`, `button: Open inbox`, `button: Help & Documentation`, `button: AA` (avatar) |
| header text | `ObjectOS` | `PREVIEW / Studio AA` |
| header height | 40.5 px | 56 px (the `/home` header's) |
| at 390 px | `a: Back to home -> /home` | `a: ObjectOS -> /home`, inbox, avatar (help is `md` and up, as on `/home`) |
| avatar menu | (none) | Ada Admin, Profile, My Workspaces, Create workspace, Theme, Language, In-app alerts, Desktop notifications, Log out |
| page errors | none | none |

CONTROL: `/home` on both trees draws the same three controls at 390 px and the same menu. The provider tree: `/studio` (`StudioRoute`, then `ProtectedRoute`, then `ConnectedShell`, inside `ConsoleShell`) is the tree `/home` (`ProtectedRoute`, then `HomeLayout`) has, so `AppHeader` mounts with no new provider. The drive is the runtime reading of that: the real account menu, inbox and help rendered, with no page error.

**H2 holds.** The studio variant's brand is `AppHeader`'s logo link, `to={homePath}` from `useHomePath()`, the line `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` already pins as "top-bar brand logo". Pinned three ways: the new `AppHeader.studioVariant-11863.test.tsx` runs the real `useHomePath` over metadata apps (no declaration: `/home`; `isDefault` on `helpdesk`: `/apps/helpdesk`); `StudioRoute.test.tsx` "the front door's header brand walks back to the same home the gate bounces to" drives the real route tree with a declared landing (`/apps/cloud_control`); and the browser drive above (`/home`).

**H3 holds.** `/studio` mounts no command palette, so under objectui#11987's rule the header draws no search trigger there. Pinned in `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912.test.tsx`, which now runs the `studio` variant in its no-provider case: neither trigger testid and no `aria-keyshortcuts` element, while the header itself drew. In the browser: 0 trigger testids, 0 `aria-keyshortcuts` elements, and `Ctrl+K` opens 0 palette overlays.

**H4 holds.** One new row, `console.studio.title`, in all ten packs; `console.studio.backToHome` retired from all ten with its one reader. `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx` now pins the crumb through the real `studioRoutes` and the real `AppHeader` (with `t` answering `«key»`), pins that no text or attribute on the landing asks for the retired key, and keeps the Han sweep with its live control. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` are green (readings below). The i18n suite's `untranslated-identity-4376` flagged the row in zh/ja/ko/ru/ar as identical to en, so it is allowlisted there with its reason (the product name).

**H5: every consumer of `AppHeaderVariant`, and what it does with `studio`.**

| Consumer | With `studio` |
|---|---|
| `resolvedVariant` default (`appName ? 'app' : 'home'`) | unchanged |
| `isApp` (`=== 'app'`): sidebar trigger, app crumbs, presence, connection dot, Design in Studio, the keyboard-shortcuts help entry, the logo hidden below `sm` | false, so none of them; the logo shows at every width, as on `home` / `orgs` |
| `=== 'home'`: the product wordmark text | not drawn |
| `=== 'orgs'`: the Workspaces crumb | not drawn |
| `=== 'studio'` (new): the Studio crumb | drawn |
| `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912.test.tsx`, `Record` over the union (exhaustive) | gains `studio: '/studio'`; compiles (`app-shell` `type-check`, whose test project lists the file) |
| `AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx`, two "every variant" loops (not exhaustive) | `studio` added to both, so their titles stay true; a comment that spelled the union out now points at the type |
| Mount sites: `HomeLayout`, `AiChatPage` (`home`), `OrganizationsLayout`, `OrganizationLayout` (`orgs`), `ConsoleLayout` (`app`) | unchanged; `StudioLanding` is the one `studio` mount |

No `switch` over the variant exists in `app-shell` or `apps/console`. `apps/console` has no comparison over it.

**H6: the budget.** `pnpm check:eager-closure`, local `vite build` of the console under the shared verify lock, each tree on its own build:

- base `054fd8441`: 3,391,274 B gzipped (`3311.8 KB`, headroom `0.2 KB`, 336 of 2458 chunks);
- this branch: 3,391,194 B gzipped (`3311.7 KB`, headroom `0.3 KB`, 336 of 2458 chunks);
- ceiling `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3,391,484 B, untouched. Delta: -80 B. The `index` chunk (the one whose built code carries the `studio` variant prop) fell 51 B; the rest is hash-rename noise spread across chunks.

The branch build ran at `19fb06ccb`; every commit after it touches test files only (`git diff --stat 19fb06ccb HEAD` lists five test files), none of which is in the bundle. The local base reading is 9 B above the 3,391,265 B the seat quoted from the queue-built tree.

## Tests

New: `AppHeader.studioVariant-11863.test.tsx` (the frame, brand first then the crumb, and neither sibling variant's drawing; CONTROL: `home` and `orgs` draw no Studio crumb; the brand's target with and without a declared landing; the right-hand cluster's inbox, help and account-menu keys). Changed: `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx` (rewritten to pin the crumb), `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912.test.tsx` and `AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx` (the `studio` member), and `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` (one allowlist row). `StudioRoute.test.tsx`, `StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798.test.tsx` and `StudioRoute.recentPackage-11863.test.tsx` render the landing, so they now mount the real `AppHeader`, whose inbox, approvals and AI-catalogue reads reached a real socket (the network-escape guard turned red on the first run); each stubs `fetch` with an empty answer, and the entry gate's read stays on the mocked `createAuthenticatedFetch`. Their wordmark wording now names the header brand. No assertion in those three changed.

Reverse verification, from the committed `555028609`, run under the verify lock:

- Leg A (behaviour): `AppHeader.tsx` and `StudioRoute.tsx` swapped to their base content (disk blobs `0de4209e7fc1` and `e657a9f63280`, equal to the base blobs; anchor counts `console.studio.title` 1 to 0, `variant="studio"` 1 to 0, `console.studio.backToHome` 0 to 1). Four files: `Tests 5 failed | 29 passed (34)`. Red: the new test's "draws the brand, then the Studio crumb"; the landing test's crumb, retired-key and brand-link cases, and its Han sweep (it waits for the crumb first). Green: the 22 `StudioRoute.test.tsx` and lazy-builder cases, the two Han-instrument controls, and the new test's two variant CONTROLs, brand-target and cluster cases, which hold on any off-app variant. A trap restored both from `HEAD`: blobs `c9bf2c535f50` and `9e2098ca83a9` equal to HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg B (types): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) on `StudioRoute.tsx`, `variant="studio"` to `variant="studioX"` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `9e2098ca83a9` to `a4295167badf`), then the console's `tsc --noEmit` against the rebuilt `app-shell` dist: exit 2, `error TS2820: Type '"studioX"' is not assignable to type 'AppHeaderVariant | undefined'. Did you mean '"studio"'?`. The suggestion names the rebuilt member, so the console read the rebuilt `.d.ts`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Union, at `c48ef5bf8` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`, the last commit), from the worktree root under the verify lock:

- every test that imports or names `AppHeader` or `StudioRoute`, or names a `console.studio.` key (39 files, from `git grep -l`; the new test is one of them): `Test Files 39 passed (39)` · `Tests 330 passed (330)`;
- `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 82 passed (82)` · `Tests 1316 passed | 13 skipped (1329)`;
- `scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files 179 passed | 2 skipped (181)` · `Tests 5452 passed | 2 skipped (5454)`;
- type-check, after building the console's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'`, `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`, exit 0, each script name echoed (`packages/i18n type-check$`, `packages/app-shell type-check$`, `apps/console type-check$`). `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows the app-shell test project and the console project list every touched test file.

## Gates

At `c48ef5bf8`, all exit 0:

- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: "Every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack (3307 keys)…";
- `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: "No en value changed in this range." (1 key added, 1 removed);
- `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only): the same 3307 pack keys and 340 candidates as on base `054fd8441`; no `console.studio` key among them;
- `pnpm check:readme-exports`: OK, 579 self-imports judged, 579 real, 0 fabricated, 0 unbuilt (after the doc-snippet build closure);
- `pnpm check:skill-examples`: "Every marked skill example holds up against the built types.";
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets`: "784 of 784 block(s) judged, 0 failed.";
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "20 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"; `check-changeset-no-major`: no `major`;
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only): one pending changeset names a file this edits, `.changeset/11806-login-server-unreachable.md` naming `packages/app-shell/README.md`. Its paragraph is about the sign-up table, which this does not touch, so it is still true;
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: no test source names a pending changeset;
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)";
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.

Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 20 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (the count is from its JSON output): 0 errors. Each of the 19 files that exist on base carries the same error and warning counts as its base content linted the same way; the new test file has 0 errors and 13 warnings, of the two kinds its sibling `11912` test carries. The config applies to `**/*.{ts,tsx}` and is not type-aware (`eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

Bundle Analysis on this PR: NOT MEASURED here, it had not posted when this was written.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts` labels its `StudioRoute.tsx` site "the /studio entry gate + the front door wordmark", and its header lists `StudioRoute.test.tsx` the same way. The front door's link is now `AppHeader`'s logo, which `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` already pins; the site's regex still matches the entry gate. The label is stale prose only, and the file is outside this claim, so it is not edited. Carrier: Q2 of #11863 or whoever next touches that file.
- No guide under `content/docs/guide/` names the header's variants (`git grep AppHeader` there: two mentions, neither a variant list), so no guide changed.
- The header's Help menu shows "This app's docs" from the navigation context's `currentAppName`, which no off-app frame clears; `/studio` inherits that from `home` / `orgs` unchanged. Read-only inference, noted, not filed.

This was implemented by the dev seat for objectui#11863 (Q1), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DBZ9bntPZ7VKyQNtJeNsgw`.
